tools.name: autocomplete_regions
tools.description: Suggest holiday regions by (partial) name, typo-tolerant. Names are matched in the response language, with German (the native names, e.g. "Seenplatte") always accepted as well. Returns region ids usable as regionId in search_accommodations, with accommodation counts.

query.description: Search text; honest 2-char minimum, no silent truncation

level.description: Restrict to one region hierarchy level (1..8); omit for any

locale.description: Language the user is writing in (de, en, fr, pl, it, es, nl, hr); defaults to de. Selects the language of names and texts in the response and the language region names are matched in — pass it on every call.

tools.name: search_accommodations
tools.description: Paginated holiday accommodation search over directly bookable/inquirable own inventory (externally managed listings are not exposed). Filter by region (regionId from autocomplete_regions), a radius around a point (lat/lng/radiusKm — use the coordinates of the place the user names; results then carry distanceKm and can be sorted by distance) or a map bounding box (neLat/neLng/swLat/swLng); these three are mutually exclusive. Travel dates (arrival/departure, both together; add bookableOnly to drop stays below the minimum stay), persons (a minimum: beds ≥ persons — add personsMax to exclude oversized houses; optional adults split for families — children can use extra-children slots), bedrooms, bathrooms, livingSpaceMin (m²), minReviews, price range per night, feature codes (e.g. swimming_pool, wifi, pets_allowed), accommodation types and offers. Sort: relevance (default), rating (best first; website formula, a single 5.0 review outranks many 4.8s — use minReviews), persons, bedrooms, living_area, distance (radius searches). Every result carries `url` (the listing page on the website of the locale) and, on dated searches, `stayUrl` with dates and guests pre-filled — give these to the user as the link. `location.place` is the actual town; `location.region` is the (marketing) region it is listed under. Dated searches include a stayPrice per result: the exact total for the stay incl. mandatory costs and discounts (kind "total"; "min_stay" when the stay is below the minimum), or "from"/"on_request" where only the static basePrice or no price is available. `approximate: true` means some nights were priced from the owner's base price; the website confirms the final total.

regionId.description: Region to search in (from /regions/autocomplete); omit to search everywhere

query.description: Keyword search over names and descriptions in the response language and the German originals

bookableOnly.description: Dated searches only: keep only stays that meet the minimum stay (drops stayPrice.kind "min_stay" results)

persons.description: Minimum sleeping places (beds ≥ persons); combine with personsMax to cap size

personsMax.description: Maximum sleeping places (beds ≤ personsMax); excludes oversized houses

minReviews.description: Only accommodations with at least this many visible reviews

adults.description: Adults among persons; when below persons, objects may host the remainder as extra children (website guests widget parity)

priceMin.description: Per night with dates, base price without

priceMax.description: Omit for unbounded — no sentinel values

radiusKm.description: Radius around the centre in km (as the crow flies), max 300

locale.description: Language the user is writing in (de, en, fr, pl, it, es, nl, hr); defaults to de. Selects the language of names and texts in the response and the language region names are matched in — pass it on every call.

tools.name: get_accommodation
tools.description: Full localized detail of one accommodation: description, location with coordinates, capacity, rating, feature codes, image gallery, base price, and `url` (the listing page on the website of the locale).

locale.description: Language the user is writing in (de, en, fr, pl, it, es, nl, hr); defaults to de. Selects the language of names and texts in the response and the language region names are matched in — pass it on every call.

tools.name: get_accommodation_availability
tools.description: Per-day availability for one accommodation: bookable days, arrival/departure flags, minimum stay, nightly price and discounts. Window defaults to today and is capped at 24 months.
